evidence.note: אַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר identifies the bearer as “Amraphel, king of Shinar.”
וְאַמְרָפֶל מֶלֶךְ שִׁנְעָר again names Amraphel as king of Shinar, this time among the four kings arrayed against the five.

name: אַמְרָפֶל
summary: Amraphel is the king of Shinar named in Genesis 14:1 and 14:9. The derivation of his name is uncertain.
